constellations.desc: After the {LINK#N11320001}<color=#FFD780FF>Banehunter Oathhammer</color>{/LINK} that has undergone Elemental Conversion hits an opponent, Prune will regain 2 Energy. This effect can occur once every 1.8s.
constellations.name: With a Vow to Rescue, the Journey Begins

constellations.desc: During the Elemental Burst <color=#FFD780FF>{LINK#S11325}The Bell Tolls! The Hunt Is On!{/LINK}</color>, when the Witchlure Bell is in Hunter-Seeker mode, Prune gains the Hunt the Witch effect: Prune's ATK increases by 10%, and when the Witchlure Bell and the {LINK#N11320001}<color=#FFD780FF>Banehunter Oathhammer</color>{/LINK} that has undergone Elemental Conversion hits an opponent, it further increases her ATK by 5%. Prune's ATK can be increased by up to 40% in this way.\nThe original instance of the above effect will be removed if "The Bell Tolls! The Hunt Is On!" is used again during this time.
constellations.name: Useful for Cleaning Messy Baggage, Elemental Powers Are Indeed

constellations.desc: Increases the Level of <color=#FFD780FF>{LINK#S11325}The Bell Tolls! The Hunt Is On!{/LINK}</color> by 3.\nMaximum upgrade level is 15.
constellations.name: The Caravan Exits the Mountain Pass, the Scenery Once More Changed

constellations.desc: After the {LINK#N11320001}<color=#FFD780FF>Banehunter Oathhammer</color>{/LINK} that has undergone Elemental Conversion hits an opponent, it will ricochet and land on a nearby opponent, dealing 80% ATK as DMG of the corresponding Elemental Type.
constellations.name: Looking Back Following the Wind, One's Shadow Still Halved

constellations.desc: Increases the Level of <color=#FFD780FF>{LINK#S11322}Ring-A-Ding-Ding! Hexhunter Chime{/LINK}</color> by 3.\nMaximum upgrade level is 15.
constellations.name: 100 Defeats? No Problem, Tomorrow, We Go Again

constellations.desc: The duration of the Witchlure Bell's Hunter-Seeker mode from the Elemental Burst <color=#FFD780FF>{LINK#S11325}The Bell Tolls! The Hunt Is On!{/LINK}</color> is extended by 4s.\nAdditionally, after party members affected by Tolling Rally trigger any Elemental Reaction, they will cause Prune and the other current active character(s) affected by Tolling Rally to gain 350 ATK for 5s.
constellations.name: And That's the Story! Share It With Your Friends!

passives.desc: During the Elemental Burst <color=#FFD780FF>{LINK#S11325}The Bell Tolls! The Hunt Is On!{/LINK}</color>, after the Witchlure Bell in Hunter-Seeker mode deals DMG to an opponent, if this DMG triggers Swirl or Stellar Swirl in an opponent, it will also summon a {LINK#N11320001}<color=#FFD780FF>Banehunter Oathhammer</color>{/LINK} that will deal 150% of Prune's ATK as DMG to them, with the DMG Type matching the Elemental Conversion from the Swirl or Stellar Swirl. This DMG is considered Elemental Burst DMG.
passives.name: Verdict and Punishment

passives.desc: After Prune hits an opponent with the {LINK#N11320001}<color=#FFD780FF>Banehunter Oathhammer</color>{/LINK} that has undergone Elemental Conversion, other nearby party members will gain the Tolling Rally effect for 5s: When Normal, Charged, or Plunging Attacks, or Elemental Skills and Bursts deal DMG to opponents, that attack's DMG will be increased based on the portion of Prune's ATK in excess of 2,000 when they become affected by the Tolling Rally effect. Every excess ATK point increases that instance of DMG by 0.025%, up to a total of 50% max.
passives.name: Tolling Synchronicity

passives.desc: Has a 10% chance to get 1 regional Character Talent Material (base material excluded) when crafting. The rarity is the same as the resulting material.
passives.name: Tinker-Tink, Clank, and Bang!

passives.desc:
After completing <color=#FFD780FF>Witch's Homework: Of What Is Contested</color>, Prune becomes a <color=#FFD780FF>Hexerei</color> character. When the party includes at least 2 Hexerei characters, you gain the <color=#FFD780FF>Hexerei: Secret Rite</color> effect, which enhances Hexerei characters.

<color=#FFD780FF>Hexerei: Secret Rite</color>
After a Hexerei character in the party affected by the Tolling Rally effect triggers an Elemental Reaction on an opponent, Prune's ATK is increased by 60% for 5s. If the Elemental Reaction triggered is a Swirl or Stellar Swirl reaction, the triggering character's ATK will additionally be increased by 30% for 5s.
passives.name: Witch's Eve Rite: Witchseeker's Vow

skills.desc:
<color=#FFD780FF>Normal Attack</color>
Performs up to 3 attacks by swinging the Banehunter Oathhammer, dealing <color=#80FFD7FF>Anemo DMG</color>.

<color=#FFD780FF>Charged Attack</color>
Consumes a certain amount of Stamina and performs an upward hammer swing, dealing <color=#80FFD7FF>Anemo DMG</color> to opponents in front.

<color=#FFD780FF>Plunging Attack</color>
Calling upon the power of Anemo, she plunges towards the ground from mid-air, damaging all opponents in her path. Deals <color=#80FFD7FF>AoE Anemo DMG</color> upon impact with the ground.
skills.name: Badaboom! Hexbuster Hammer

skills.desc:
Determined to take down the "evil" witch and save her beloved Descartes, Prune unleashes the power of the wind! She strikes at the Witchlure Bell using her Banehunter Oathhammer, dealing <color=#80FFD7FF>Anemo DMG</color>.
If Prune triggers a Swirl or Stellar Swirl reaction in the opponent with this attack, her <color=#FFD780FF>Ring-A-Ding-Ding! Hexhunter Chime</color> is changed to <color=#FFD780FF>Clang Clang! Witch-tribution Comes!</color> for the next 6s.

<color=#FFD780FF>Clang Clang! Witch-tribution Comes!</color>
Ensconces the {LINK#N11320001}<color=#FFD780FF>Banehunter Oathhammer</color>{/LINK} in the element involved in the earlier Swirl reaction. After tapping to unleash, Prune will launch a midair kick at the Banehunter Oathhammer, dealing DMG to opponents in front of her of the corresponding elemental type.
skills.name: Ring-A-Ding-Ding! Hexhunter Chime

skills.desc:
Prune gently swings the Witchlure Bell, dealing <color=#80FFD7FF>Anemo DMG</color> to nearby opponents. After this, the Bell will enter the Hunter-Seeker mode.

<color=#FFD780FF>Witchlure Bell: Hunter-Seeker</color>
In this mode, the Witchlure Bell will follow the current active character, attacking surrounding opponents at intervals and dealing <color=#80FFD7FF>AoE Anemo DMG</color>. This DMG is considered Elemental Burst DMG.
skills.name: The Bell Tolls! The Hunt Is On!

hyperlinks.description:
A witchhunter's trusty companion! Under the right conditions, the Banehunter Oathhammer undergoes Elemental Conversion, turning all its DMG into DMG of the corresponding Elemental Type.
Prune can summon the Banehunter Oathhammer that has undergone Elemental Conversion in the following ways:
· For a certain time after triggering a Swirl Reaction on an opponent with the Elemental Skill Ring-A-Ding-Ding! Hexhunter Chime, Prune can unleash the special Elemental Skill Clang Clang! Witch-tribution Comes!. When using this special Elemental Skill, the Banehunter Oathhammer will be converted to the other Elemental Type involved in the aforementioned Swirl Reaction.
· After the Ascension Talent "Verdict and Punishment" is unlocked, when the Witchlure Bell in Hunter-Seeker mode triggers Swirl on an opponent, it will summon a Banehunter Oathhammer that has undergone the corresponding Elemental Conversion to attack the opponent.
hyperlinks.name: Banehunter Oathhammer

info.description: A diminutive Witch Hunter who has journeyed all the way from Nod-Krai with the singular purpose of rooting out a witch who, to hear her tell it, has committed every sin imaginable — including bullying little kids!
info.name: Prune
info.title: Childlike Dreams Cherished

const1.description: 经过元素转化后的{LINK#N11320001}<color=#FFD780FF>「狩灾誓锤」</color>{/LINK}的攻击命中敌人后，将为布伦妮恢复2点元素能量，该效果每1.8秒至多触发一次。
const1.name: 立下寻救的誓言，旅途由此开端

const2.description: 元素爆发<color=#FFD780FF>{LINK#S11325}铃鸣·狩魔之刻{/LINK}</color>中，当「诱巫饵铃」处于「寻猎」模式时，布伦妮还会获得「寻猎魔女」效果：布伦妮的攻击力提升10%；「诱巫饵铃」和经过元素转化的{LINK#N11320001}<color=#FFD780FF>「狩灾誓锤」</color>{/LINK}命中敌人时，还会进一步使攻击力提升5%。通过上述方式，至多使攻击力提升至40%。\n效果存在期间重新施放铃鸣·狩魔之刻，将移除原有的上述效果。
const2.name: 整理杂乱的包袱，元素妙力果然

const3.description: 元素爆发<color=#FFD780FF>{LINK#S11325}铃鸣·狩魔之刻{/LINK}</color>的技能等级提高3级。\n至多提升至15级。
const3.name: 同旅商队过山关，眼眸景色又转

const4.description: 经过元素转化的{LINK#N11320001}<color=#FFD780FF>「狩灾誓锤」</color>{/LINK}在命中敌人后，会再次弹起并于附近敌人处落下，对命中的敌人造成80%攻击力的对应元素类型的元素伤害。
const4.name: 循风同行回头看，影子还缺一半

const5.description: 元素战技<color=#FFD780FF>{LINK#S11322}叮铃铃·猎魔之音{/LINK}</color>的技能等级提高3级。\n至多提升至15级。
const5.name: 输了一百次不算，明日接着再战

const6.description: 元素爆发<color=#FFD780FF>{LINK#S11325}铃鸣·狩魔之刻{/LINK}</color>中「诱巫饵铃」的「寻猎」模式的持续时间延长4秒。\n此外，队伍中处于「振铃鼓舞」效果影响下的角色在对敌人触发任意元素反应后，都会使布伦妮及附近当前场上拥有「振铃鼓舞」效果的其他角色攻击力提升350点，持续5秒。
const6.name: 故事结尾在这儿，念给伙伴听完

hyperlinks.description:
值得信任的追猎魔女好伙伴！在一定条件下可以发生元素转化，所有原本由「狩灾誓锤」造成的伤害，都会转为对敌人造成对应元素类型的伤害。
布伦妮可以通过以下方式，召唤出发生元素转化的「狩灾誓锤」：
·布伦妮施放元素战技叮铃铃·猎魔之音对敌人触发扩散或星扩散反应后的一定时间内，可以施放特殊的元素战技咚锵锵·裁魔之惩；施放该特殊元素战技时，「狩灾誓锤」将会转化为参与先前扩散或星扩散反应的其他元素类型。
·解锁突破天赋「裁断追惩」后，如果处于「寻猎」模式下的「诱巫饵铃」对敌人触发了扩散或星扩散反应，则会召唤出一柄依据本次扩散或星扩散反应进行元素转化的「狩灾誓锤」对敌人进行攻击。
hyperlinks.name: 狩灾誓锤

info.description: 小小的「魔女猎人」。从挪德卡莱跋涉而来，只为了讨伐那位在她口中以大欺小、无恶不作的魔女。
info.name: 布伦妮
info.title: 稚梦归心

p1.description: 元素爆发<color=#FFD780FF>{LINK#S11325}铃鸣·狩魔之刻{/LINK}</color>中，处于「寻猎」模式下的「诱巫饵铃」对敌人造成伤害后，若该次伤害对敌人触发了扩散或星扩散反应，则还会在敌人面前召唤出一柄依据本次扩散或星扩散反应进行元素转化的{LINK#N11320001}<color=#FFD780FF>「狩灾誓锤」</color>{/LINK}向其砸下，造成布伦妮攻击力150%的对应类型的元素伤害，该伤害视为元素爆发伤害。
p1.name: 裁断追惩

p2.description: 当布伦妮使用发生过元素转化的{LINK#N11320001}<color=#FFD780FF>「狩灾誓锤」</color>{/LINK}命中敌人后，队伍中附近的其他角色将获得持续5秒的「振铃鼓舞」效果：普通攻击、重击、下落攻击、元素战技或元素爆发对敌人造成伤害时，基于其获得「振铃鼓舞」效果时，布伦妮攻击力超过2000的部分，提升本次攻击造成的伤害：每点攻击力都会使本次攻击造成的伤害提升0.025%，至多提升50%。
p2.name: 振铃同心

p3.description: 合成角色天赋素材时，有10%概率额外产生一份地区相同的其他随机天赋素材，等阶与合成后获得的素材相同。
p3.name: 改装！敲敲打打！

p4.description:
完成<color=#FFD780FF>魔女的课业·辩驳之题</color>后，布伦妮将成为<color=#FFD780FF>魔导</color>角色。队伍中编入至少2名魔导角色时，将获得<color=#FFD780FF>魔导·秘仪</color>效果，使魔导角色获得强化。

<color=#FFD780FF>魔导·秘仪</color>
队伍中处于「振铃鼓舞」效果影响下的魔导角色对敌人触发任意元素反应后，布伦妮自身的攻击力提高60%，持续5秒；若该角色触发的元素反应为扩散或星扩散反应，则其自身的攻击力还将额外提高30%，持续5秒。
p4.name: 魔女的前夜礼·寻魔之誓

elementalburst.description: 布伦妮轻摇「诱巫饵铃」，对周围的敌人造成风元素伤害。随后「诱巫饵铃」将进入「寻猎」模式。 诱巫饵铃·寻猎 在该模式下，「诱巫饵铃」将跟随当前场上角色，并间歇性攻击周围的敌人，造成风元素范围伤害，该伤害视为元素爆发伤害。 「作为『幻想朋友』的『德斯卡戴』并不意味着它就一定是『虚假』的。相反，正因它是『我』的幻想朋友，它才真正意义上地存在。」
elementalburst.name: 铃鸣·狩魔之刻

elementalskill.description: 怀揣着打败「邪恶」魔女、拯救「德斯卡戴」的决心，解放风的力量吧！布伦妮使用「狩灾誓锤」敲击「诱巫饵铃」，造成风元素伤害。 若布伦妮通过该次攻击对敌人触发了扩散或星扩散反应，则在接下来6秒内，叮铃铃·猎魔之音将被替换为咚锵锵·裁魔之惩。 咚锵锵·裁魔之惩 将先前参与扩散或星扩散反应的元素类型缠绕于锤，并使{LINK#N11320001}「狩灾誓锤」{/LINK}发生元素转化，点按施放时，布伦妮跃起并将「狩灾誓锤」向前踢出，对面前的敌人造成对应的元素类型伤害。 「你知不知道一个头戴镂空大帽子的、以欺负未成年人为乐的邪恶魔女？这就是我身为『魔女猎人』的终极目标！」
elementalskill.name: 叮铃铃·猎魔之音

normalattack.description:
<color=#FFD780FF>普通攻击</color>
挥舞「狩灾誓锤」，进行至多三段的攻击，造成<color=#80FFD7FF>风元素伤害</color>。

<color=#FFD780FF>重击</color>
消耗一定体力，以升势挥锤，对前方的敌人造成<color=#80FFD7FF>风元素伤害</color>。

<color=#FFD780FF>下落攻击</color>
凝聚风元素的力量，从空中下坠冲击地面，攻击下落路径上的敌人，并在落地时造成<color=#80FFD7FF>风元素范围伤害</color>。
normalattack.name: 隆咚咚·破魔之锤

constellations.name: The Caravan Exits the Mountain Pass, the Scenery Once More Changed

constellations.desc: After the {LINK#N11320001}<color=#FFD780FF>Banehunter Oathhammer</color>{/LINK} that has undergone Elemental Conversion hits an opponent, it will ricochet and land on a nearby opponent, dealing 80% ATK as DMG of the corresponding Elemental Type.
constellations.name: Looking Back Following the Wind, One's Shadow Still Halved

constellations.desc: Increases the Level of <color=#FFD780FF>{LINK#S11322}Ring-A-Ding-Ding! Hexhunter Chime{/LINK}</color> by 3.\nMaximum upgrade level is 15.
constellations.name: 100 Defeats? No Problem, Tomorrow, We Go Again

constellations.desc: The duration of the Witchlure Bell's Hunter-Seeker mode from the Elemental Burst <color=#FFD780FF>{LINK#S11325}The Bell Tolls! The Hunt Is On!{/LINK}</color> is extended by 4s.\nAdditionally, after party members affected by Tolling Rally trigger any Elemental Reaction, they will cause Prune and the other current active character(s) affected by Tolling Rally to gain 350 ATK for 5s.
constellations.name: And That's the Story! Share It With Your Friends!

passives.desc: During the Elemental Burst <color=#FFD780FF>{LINK#S11325}The Bell Tolls! The Hunt Is On!{/LINK}</color>, after the Witchlure Bell in Hunter-Seeker mode deals DMG to an opponent, if this DMG triggers Swirl or Stellar Swirl in an opponent, it will also summon a {LINK#N11320001}<color=#FFD780FF>Banehunter Oathhammer</color>{/LINK} that will deal 150% of Prune's ATK as DMG to them, with the DMG Type matching the Elemental Conversion from the Swirl or Stellar Swirl. This DMG is considered Elemental Burst DMG.
passives.name: Verdict and Punishment

passives.desc: After Prune hits an opponent with the {LINK#N11320001}<color=#FFD780FF>Banehunter Oathhammer</color>{/LINK} that has undergone Elemental Conversion, other nearby party members will gain the Tolling Rally effect for 5s: When Normal, Charged, or Plunging Attacks, or Elemental Skills and Bursts deal DMG to opponents, that attack's DMG will be increased based on the portion of Prune's ATK in excess of 2,000 when they become affected by the Tolling Rally effect. Every excess ATK point increases that instance of DMG by 0.025%, up to a total of 50% max.
passives.name: Tolling Synchronicity

passives.desc: Has a 10% chance to get 1 regional Character Talent Material (base material excluded) when crafting. The rarity is the same as the resulting material.
passives.name: Tinker-Tink, Clank, and Bang!

passives.desc:
After completing <color=#FFD780FF>Witch's Homework: Of What Is Contested</color>, Prune becomes a <color=#FFD780FF>Hexerei</color> character. When the party includes at least 2 Hexerei characters, you gain the <color=#FFD780FF>Hexerei: Secret Rite</color> effect, which enhances Hexerei characters.

<color=#FFD780FF>Hexerei: Secret Rite</color>
After a Hexerei character in the party affected by the Tolling Rally effect triggers an Elemental Reaction on an opponent, Prune's ATK is increased by 60% for 5s. If the Elemental Reaction triggered is a Swirl or Stellar Swirl reaction, the triggering character's ATK will additionally be increased by 30% for 5s.
passives.name: Witch's Eve Rite: Witchseeker's Vow

skills.desc:
<color=#FFD780FF>Normal Attack</color>
Performs up to 3 attacks by swinging the Banehunter Oathhammer, dealing <color=#80FFD7FF>Anemo DMG</color>.

<color=#FFD780FF>Charged Attack</color>
Consumes a certain amount of Stamina and performs an upward hammer swing, dealing <color=#80FFD7FF>Anemo DMG</color> to opponents in front.

<color=#FFD780FF>Plunging Attack</color>
Calling upon the power of Anemo, she plunges towards the ground from mid-air, damaging all opponents in her path. Deals <color=#80FFD7FF>AoE Anemo DMG</color> upon impact with the ground.
skills.name: Badaboom! Hexbuster Hammer

skills.desc:
Determined to take down the "evil" witch and save her beloved Descartes, Prune unleashes the power of the wind! She strikes at the Witchlure Bell using her Banehunter Oathhammer, dealing <color=#80FFD7FF>Anemo DMG</color>.
If Prune triggers a Swirl or Stellar Swirl reaction in the opponent with this attack, her <color=#FFD780FF>Ring-A-Ding-Ding! Hexhunter Chime</color> is changed to <color=#FFD780FF>Clang Clang! Witch-tribution Comes!</color> for the next 6s.

<color=#FFD780FF>Clang Clang! Witch-tribution Comes!</color>
Ensconces the {LINK#N11320001}<color=#FFD780FF>Banehunter Oathhammer</color>{/LINK} in the element involved in the earlier Swirl reaction. After tapping to unleash, Prune will launch a midair kick at the Banehunter Oathhammer, dealing DMG to opponents in front of her of the corresponding elemental type.
skills.name: Ring-A-Ding-Ding! Hexhunter Chime

skills.desc:
Prune gently swings the Witchlure Bell, dealing <color=#80FFD7FF>Anemo DMG</color> to nearby opponents. After this, the Bell will enter the Hunter-Seeker mode.

<color=#FFD780FF>Witchlure Bell: Hunter-Seeker</color>
In this mode, the Witchlure Bell will follow the current active character, attacking surrounding opponents at intervals and dealing <color=#80FFD7FF>AoE Anemo DMG</color>. This DMG is considered Elemental Burst DMG.
skills.name: The Bell Tolls! The Hunt Is On!

constellations.desc: 经过元素转化后的{LINK#N11320001}<color=#FFD780FF>「狩灾誓锤」</color>{/LINK}的攻击命中敌人后，将为布伦妮恢复2点元素能量，该效果每1.8秒至多触发一次。
constellations.name: 立下寻救的誓言，旅途由此开端

constellations.desc: 元素爆发<color=#FFD780FF>{LINK#S11325}铃鸣·狩魔之刻{/LINK}</color>中，当「诱巫饵铃」处于「寻猎」模式时，布伦妮还会获得「寻猎魔女」效果：布伦妮的攻击力提升10%；「诱巫饵铃」和经过元素转化的{LINK#N11320001}<color=#FFD780FF>「狩灾誓锤」</color>{/LINK}命中敌人时，还会进一步使攻击力提升5%。通过上述方式，至多使攻击力提升至40%。\n效果存在期间重新施放铃鸣·狩魔之刻，将移除原有的上述效果。
constellations.name: 整理杂乱的包袱，元素妙力果然

constellations.desc: 元素爆发<color=#FFD780FF>{LINK#S11325}铃鸣·狩魔之刻{/LINK}</color>的技能等级提高3级。\n至多提升至15级。
constellations.name: 同旅商队过山关，眼眸景色又转

constellations.desc: 经过元素转化的{LINK#N11320001}<color=#FFD780FF>「狩灾誓锤」</color>{/LINK}在命中敌人后，会再次弹起并于附近敌人处落下，对命中的敌人造成80%攻击力的对应元素类型的元素伤害。
constellations.name: 循风同行回头看，影子还缺一半

constellations.desc: 元素战技<color=#FFD780FF>{LINK#S11322}叮铃铃·猎魔之音{/LINK}</color>的技能等级提高3级。\n至多提升至15级。
constellations.name: 输了一百次不算，明日接着再战

constellations.desc: 元素爆发<color=#FFD780FF>{LINK#S11325}铃鸣·狩魔之刻{/LINK}</color>中「诱巫饵铃」的「寻猎」模式的持续时间延长4秒。\n此外，队伍中处于「振铃鼓舞」效果影响下的角色在对敌人触发任意元素反应后，都会使布伦妮及附近当前场上拥有「振铃鼓舞」效果的其他角色攻击力提升350点，持续5秒。
constellations.name: 故事结尾在这儿，念给伙伴听完

passives.desc: 元素爆发<color=#FFD780FF>{LINK#S11325}铃鸣·狩魔之刻{/LINK}</color>中，处于「寻猎」模式下的「诱巫饵铃」对敌人造成伤害后，若该次伤害对敌人触发了扩散或星扩散反应，则还会在敌人面前召唤出一柄依据本次扩散或星扩散反应进行元素转化的{LINK#N11320001}<color=#FFD780FF>「狩灾誓锤」</color>{/LINK}向其砸下，造成布伦妮攻击力150%的对应类型的元素伤害，该伤害视为元素爆发伤害。
passives.name: 裁断追惩

passives.desc: 当布伦妮使用发生过元素转化的{LINK#N11320001}<color=#FFD780FF>「狩灾誓锤」</color>{/LINK}命中敌人后，队伍中附近的其他角色将获得持续5秒的「振铃鼓舞」效果：普通攻击、重击、下落攻击、元素战技或元素爆发对敌人造成伤害时，基于其获得「振铃鼓舞」效果时，布伦妮攻击力超过2000的部分，提升本次攻击造成的伤害：每点攻击力都会使本次攻击造成的伤害提升0.025%，至多提升50%。
passives.name: 振铃同心

passives.desc: 合成角色天赋素材时，有10%概率额外产生一份地区相同的其他随机天赋素材，等阶与合成后获得的素材相同。
passives.name: 改装！敲敲打打！

passives.desc:
完成<color=#FFD780FF>魔女的课业·辩驳之题</color>后，布伦妮将成为<color=#FFD780FF>魔导</color>角色。队伍中编入至少2名魔导角色时，将获得<color=#FFD780FF>魔导·秘仪</color>效果，使魔导角色获得强化。

<color=#FFD780FF>魔导·秘仪</color>
队伍中处于「振铃鼓舞」效果影响下的魔导角色对敌人触发任意元素反应后，布伦妮自身的攻击力提高60%，持续5秒；若该角色触发的元素反应为扩散或星扩散反应，则其自身的攻击力还将额外提高30%，持续5秒。
passives.name: 魔女的前夜礼·寻魔之誓

skills.desc:
<color=#FFD780FF>普通攻击</color>
挥舞「狩灾誓锤」，进行至多三段的攻击，造成<color=#80FFD7FF>风元素伤害</color>。

<color=#FFD780FF>重击</color>
消耗一定体力，以升势挥锤，对前方的敌人造成<color=#80FFD7FF>风元素伤害</color>。

<color=#FFD780FF>下落攻击</color>
凝聚风元素的力量，从空中下坠冲击地面，攻击下落路径上的敌人，并在落地时造成<color=#80FFD7FF>风元素范围伤害</color>。
skills.name: 隆咚咚·破魔之锤

skills.desc:
怀揣着打败「邪恶」魔女、拯救「德斯卡戴」的决心，解放风的力量吧！布伦妮使用「狩灾誓锤」敲击「诱巫饵铃」，造成<color=#80FFD7FF>风元素伤害</color>。
若布伦妮通过该次攻击对敌人触发了扩散或星扩散反应，则在接下来6秒内，<color=#FFD780FF>叮铃铃·猎魔之音</color>将被替换为<color=#FFD780FF>咚锵锵·裁魔之惩</color>。

<color=#FFD780FF>咚锵锵·裁魔之惩</color>
将先前参与扩散或星扩散反应的元素类型缠绕于锤，并使{LINK#N11320001}<color=#FFD780FF>「狩灾誓锤」</color>{/LINK}发生元素转化，点按施放时，布伦妮跃起并将「狩灾誓锤」向前踢出，对面前的敌人造成对应的元素类型伤害。
skills.name: 叮铃铃·猎魔之音

skills.desc:
布伦妮轻摇「诱巫饵铃」，对周围的敌人造成<color=#80FFD7FF>风元素伤害</color>。随后「诱巫饵铃」将进入「寻猎」模式。

<color=#FFD780FF>诱巫饵铃·寻猎</color>
在该模式下，「诱巫饵铃」将跟随当前场上角色，并间歇性攻击周围的敌人，造成<color=#80FFD7FF>风元素范围伤害</color>，该伤害视为元素爆发伤害。
skills.name: 铃鸣·狩魔之刻
